//: brainify writes this to a hub's .claude/settings.local.example.json (committed). Each teammate copies it to .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored by pb sync). Tokens are a FALLBACK: keep only the lines for tools that don't already work. Delete GITLAB_TOKEN if `glab auth status` succeeds (the env var overrides that login). If you already have a same-named MCP server in your own Claude config, delete its token and move its name to disabledMcpjsonServers, because the project server would otherwise hide yours. SONAR_* is optional and separate: only for details the CI pipeline log doesn't show. Claude Code passes this env to Bash and to MCP server processes; ${VAR} in .mcp.json does NOT see it.

env.GITLAB_TOKEN: glpat-...  (GitLab > Preferences > Access tokens, scope: api)
env.SONAR_TOKEN: squ_...  (optional: SonarQube > My Account > Security > Generate token)
